vectors.name: formats-oml/nonfinite/nan-is-a-number
vectors.comment: C-19 and OML-30: OML spells it `nan`. E-33 encodes the non-finite number as the string `NaN`. Verified live 2026-10-18 at the ports default-branch tips: passes on Python, TypeScript, Go, Java; fails on Rust (DIV-47, expected until adopted).

vectors.comment: C-19 and OML-30: OML spells it `inf`. E-33 encodes the non-finite number as the string `Infinity`. Verified live 2026-10-18 at the ports default-branch tips: passes on Python, TypeScript, Rust, Go and Java.

vectors.name: formats-oml/nonfinite/capitalised-nan-is-a-bare-word
vectors.comment: C-19: OML's spellings are lowercase; `NaN` is a bare identifier and `parse.bare-word`, as for any other word that is not null, true or false. Verified live 2026-10-18 at the ports default-branch tips: passes on Python, TypeScript, Rust, Go and Java.
